# GameBoard

## Purpose
Owns the game board: reads the grid size and cell size from CD_GameBoard, decides where every cell sits in the world, draws the framed grid and announces the board's bounds.

## Concepts
game board, grid, cell, cell size, board bounds, CD_GameBoard, GameBoardCVO, IGameBoardModel
